findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A)  There was no certified food protection manager present during today’s inspection. There was however one person with a food handler who is currently enrolled and in the process of writing the exam. Ensure that there is at least one food protection manager present during operation at all times. 

 Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(C) There was no sanitizer observed in the kitchen and at the bar. PIC was made aware and sani buckets were made. The quaternary ammonium sanitizer buckets tested at 300 ppm. Ensure that there is always sanitizer solution available during food prep and food handling. 


 Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed there was not a sanitizer bucket available at the bar or kitchen. The facility was operating during the inspection. The PIC made sanitizer buckets during the inspection. Ensure there are always sanitizer buckets available during all hours of operation.  

4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. Observed there was not caulking present along the triple sink. It appears the triple sink was re-caulked after the last inspection but the caulking has peeled off. Discussed with the PIC. Ensure the triple sink is caulked regularly to create a smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable surface. The caulking should be replaced when it starts to peel/chip. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Bar ice machine was observed to contain mold on the left side of machine.  Food contact surfaces shall be clean to sight and touch.  Ensure ice machine is cleaned and sanitized regularly to prevent mold growth and build-up causing contamination of ice.

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.
